newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Rates quoted mixed on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Rates quoted mixed on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were mixed on Tuesday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session Monday. No barges traded versus none on Monday.
- Two barges, Memphis, Mississippi River, this week, no bid, offer 90 percent, unchanged from July 21.
- Two barges, Illinois River, next week, bid 100 percent of tariff, unchanged from July 21, offer 105 percent, no comparison.
